payload.executive_summary: The kernel issued a 'clarify' DiscoveryOutcomeCertificate because the proposing worker's recommended_outcome was 'clarify', emitting reason CLARIFY_WORKER_REQUESTED, and that recommendation is well-founded: two material blocking gaps cannot be assumed away reversibly and genuinely change what should be built. First, the source phrase 'доставки/поражения' is ambiguous between benign lunar logistics delivery and weaponized strike, reshaping ethics, features, and export-control/space-treaty posture. Second, the required physics fidelity (flat-surface parabola vs. central-gravity/Keplerian) is undecided and sets core solver complexity and the toy-vs-tool positioning. The independent readiness assessment corroborates the decision: overall_readiness='conditionally_ready' with recommended_next_action='request_clarification'. This diagnosis is advisory only and cannot change the outcome, the certificate, the settlement, or the source Proposal.

cause_analysis.description: The intended use is unresolved. The source phrase 'доставки/поражения' supports both benign logistics delivery and weaponized strike; this material unknown reshapes ethics, features, and regulatory/export-control (ITAR/EAR, Outer Space Treaty) posture, and a clean go/reject settlement cannot be made until a sponsor clarifies intent. This blocking gap is one of the two reasons the worker's recommended_outcome was 'clarify', producing the certificate's CLARIFY_WORKER_REQUESTED reason. No clarify-branch policy-trace condition FAILED: the only condition that emitted this reason code, worker_requested_clarify, is evaluation='passed' and is therefore not cited (per the clarify branch/evaluation rule); the obstacle is documented in the readiness assessment's blocking_gaps.

The required solver fidelity is unresolved. Whether the MVP uses a flat-surface parabola or central-gravity/Keplerian propagation sets core solver complexity, the toy-vs-tool positioning, and ultimately what should be built; the proposal cannot be turned into an actionable build spec without this answer. This blocking gap is the second reason the worker's recommended_outcome was 'clarify', contributing to the CLARIFY_WORKER_REQUESTED reason code. No clarify-branch policy-trace condition FAILED; the obstacle is documented in the readiness assessment's blocking_gaps.

information_requests.question: What is the intended use of the tool — benign lunar logistics delivery, or weaponized strike? A sponsor/product-owner answer resolves the delivery-vs-strike ambiguity and determines whether export-control (ITAR/EAR), Outer Space Treaty / Artemis Accords review, and weapons-related feature scoping apply.

What physics fidelity is required for the MVP — flat-surface parabola or central-gravity/Keplerian propagation — and are lunar rotation (Coriolis) and mass concentrations (mascons) in scope? This fixes core solver complexity and the toy-vs-tool positioning.

recommended_actions.description: Request that the sponsor/product owner clarify the delivery-vs-strike intent before any settlement decision; route to export-control/policy review only if the strike interpretation is confirmed.
Confirm the required physics fidelity (parabola vs. Keplerian) and the rotation/mascon scope with the requestor so the candidate_scope can be turned into a concrete build spec.
After both clarifications are received, re-run discovery with the resolved intent and fidelity target so a clean go/reject settlement can be made.

residual_risks.risk: No confirmed sponsor or customer exists; primary users are plausible but assumed, so even after the two blocking clarifications are resolved, adoption and sustainability remain unproven.

The central 'empty niche' claim (no fast in-browser 3D lunar mass-driver tool exists) rests on general domain knowledge with no competitive scan; if a competing tool exists, the product's positioning rationale weakens.

Performance and non-functional targets (trajectories per second, max simultaneous projectiles, minimum supported device class) are unspecified, leaving the technical/performance risk underscoped relative to the in-browser 3D plus integrator workload.
If the strike interpretation is later confirmed, export-control (ITAR/EAR) and space-weapons regulatory exposure may apply retroactively to design artifacts already produced.
